facts.fact: The World Bank's digital economy assessment describes the current civil registration and identification system as fragmented and on paper, with civil registration archives largely on paper and a large part of the registers destroyed in the 2013 crisis, and civil registration services still unavailable in many regions; it gives no date for the statement, and the date is its publication year.

systems.country_label: système d'enregistrement à l'état civil; services d'état civil
systems.tiers: not available in many regions of the country; archives largely on paper and largely destroyed in 2013

systems.country_label: système d'identification national; carte d'identité nationale; attestation d'identité
systems.tiers: national identity cards not being issued at the time of the assessment, a three-month identity attestation used instead; biometric data collected for passports with a private company
